notes: Two teams contesting a ball on a scored field is Sports, and the space is a rigid enclosed perimeter with the match happening inside it, so space-bounded. Physics Sport is the preset that fits: a walled ball court where the enclosure itself keeps play alive, so the goals are entrance planes registering a score (trigger-scoring), the electromagnetic sides are the stadium enclosure reworded as light walls (barrier-perimeter), and kickoff needs a static restart position (startpoint-play). I deliberately dropped trigger-bounds, which the field-sport presets carry, because the prompt says the walls keep the ball in — there is no foul line to stop play at. Deciding without a user: compact futsal footprint per the answers, open to the sky with no ceiling so nothing overhangs, one pitch rather than several courts, and the slick broadcast styling read as surface and lighting treatment rather than a request for seating, so I left bleachers off and the route stays plain P0; the match clock and score-to-win are gameplay and carry no layout.
